title: Consulting Agreement

issues.quote: Consultant shall execute a hydrology and water quality study (the "Services") for Client's proposed oyster nursery at Client's lease site in Bulls Bay, South Carolina (the "Site").
issues.why: Execute is a term of art (to sign a document); here it means perform.
issues.fix: Consultant shall perform a hydrology and water quality study ...

issues.quote: Client will provide Consultant with access to the Site and to Client's boats and docks during normal working hours.
issues.why: Will used to impose a duty on Client.
issues.fix: Client shall provide Consultant with access to the Site and to Client's boats and docks during normal working hours.

issues.quote: Client shall give Consultant copies of all water quality data for the Site that Client possesses, including but not limited to data from Client's 2025 and 2026 sampling programs.
issues.fix: including data from Client's 2025 and 2026 sampling programs.

issues.quote: Consultant's employees shall comply with Client's site safety rules while they are at the Site.
issues.why: Consultant's employees are not parties, so shall cannot bind them.
issues.fix: Consultant shall cause its employees to comply with Client's site safety rules while they are at the Site.

issues.quote: 3           Draft hydrodynamic model               Twelve Thousand Dollars ($12,000)
issues.why: Milestone table, row 3: the fee is in words and digits; house rule 2 requires digits only.
The table total says $48,000, but the 4 milestone fees add up to $46,500 ($9,500 + $14,000 + $12,000 + $11,000).
issues.fix: Reconcile: correct the total to $46,500, or correct the milestone fee that is wrong.

issues.quote: Client shall review each Deliverable and either accept it or give Consultant notice of the Deliverable's deficiencies promptly after receiving it.
issues.why: Promptly sets no deadline for Client's review, and payment depends on acceptance.
issues.fix: no later than 10 days after receiving it (and state what happens if Client doesn't respond in time).

issues.quote: Consultant shall not begin work on the second milestone until Client accepts the Deliverable for milestone 1.
issues.why: House rule 2: ordinals in digits (and the table numbers the milestones).
issues.fix: Consultant shall not begin work on milestone 2 until ...

issues.anchor: the travel expenses incurred by Consultant
issues.quote: Client shall reimburse Consultant for the travel expenses incurred by Consultant in performing the Services, up to $3,000 in total, if Consultant submits receipts for those expenses with Consultant's invoices.
issues.why: Reduced passive (with an article); a clean active form exists.
issues.fix: the travel expenses that Consultant incurs in performing the Services

issues.quote: Client may use the Deliverables for permit applications, investor presentations, grant proposals, and/or regulatory filings.
issues.why: And/or after a list of 4 items leaves unclear which combinations are allowed (severity 1 under this corpus).
issues.fix: Client may use the Deliverables for permit applications, investor presentations, grant proposals, regulatory filings, or any combination of them.

issues.quote: This agreement is binding on the parties and their respective successors and assigns.

traps.anchor: Each Deliverable is a work made for hire
traps.quote: Each Deliverable is a work made for hire for Client.
traps.why_correct: Work made for hire is the statutory term (Copyright Act); its participle is part of the term, not a recastable reduced passive.

traps.anchor: Client is not required to pay
traps.quote: Client is not required to pay for any Deliverable that Client has not accepted.
traps.why_correct: Is not required to is the house exception (MSCD 3.292).

traps.quote: The parties shall cooperate with one another in responding to any regulatory agency's questions about the Deliverables.
traps.why_correct: One is part of one another; house rule 2 keeps it.

traps.anchor: no later than 30 days after Client receives it
traps.quote: Consultant shall invoice Client for each milestone after Client accepts the related Deliverable, and Client shall pay each invoice no later than 30 days after Client receives it.
traps.why_correct: Clear deadline measured from receipt; correct.

notes: Unknown draft owner (.txt). The milestone table is typed in plain text with column spacing; the runs of spaces inside the table are layout, not sentence spacing. Issues 5 and 6 are inside the table.
